identity.name: CivicFix (PoN)

landing_page.structure: Asymmetric grid with 'Neglect Ticker' hero. High contrast sections.
landing_page.hero_style: Split screen: Left = Massive Typography 'CivicFix', Right = Live Map Visualization

dashboard.structure: Sidebar navigation. Dense data tables. 'Days Ignored' heatmaps.
dashboard.card_style: Flat, bordered, no shadow unless hovered. Information density is key.

case_detail.structure: Visual metaphor of a physical case file. Tabs look like folder tabs. Timeline is a vertical evidence chain.
case_detail.special_elements: Rubber stamp effects for status (VERIFIED, RESOLVED).

buttons.primary: bg-primary text-primary-foreground hover:bg-primary/90 shadow-[2px_2px_0px_0px_rgba(0,0,0,1)] active:translate-y-[2px] active:shadow-none transition-all

cards.evidence: bg-white border border-slate-200 p-6 relative overflow-hidden group hover:border-slate-400 transition-colors
cards.stat: bg-slate-50 border border-slate-200 p-4 flex flex-col gap-2

badges.status: px-2 py-1 text-xs font-mono font-bold uppercase tracking-wider border border-current rounded-sm

instructions_to_main_agent.general: Do not create a generic SaaS. This is a tool for civic action. It should feel slightly raw, bureaucratic but modernized (like a digital government file). Use the 'paper_grain' texture on the body background.
instructions_to_main_agent.map_integration: Use Leaflet (react-leaflet). Custom markers: Red Circle for Open, Green Check for Resolved. Map tiles should be desaturated or high-contrast (CartoDB Positron or similar free tiles).
instructions_to_main_agent.neglect_timeline: This is the core feature. It must look like a vertical timeline. Use red dots for 'Reported', yellow for 'In Progress', green for 'Resolved'. Connect them with a solid line.
instructions_to_main_agent.proof_pack: The '/proof/:caseId' page must be printable. Use '@media print' styles to hide navigation and ensure the layout fits on A4 paper. It should look like an official report.
instructions_to_main_agent.days_ignored: This metric must be the most prominent element on a case card. Use the 'stat_huge' typography style.
instructions_to_main_agent.animations: Use 'framer-motion' for the timeline nodes appearing. Staggered entrance for case lists. No bouncy, playful animations. Keep it snappy and mechanical (easeOutQuart).

universal_guidelines: Dark colors look good when used independently without gradients. DO NOT use dark colors as gradients
Don't make generic centered layouts, simplistic gradients, and uniform styling.
Create depth through layered design elements with z-index hierarchy
Use glass-morphism effects with backdrop filters (12-24px blur) sparingly - prefer solid 'paper' opacity for this specific app.
You MUST NOT apply universal transition. Eg: `transition: all`. This results in breaking transforms. Always add transitions for specific interactive elements like button, input excluding transforms
You MUST NOT center align the app container, ie do not add `.App { text-align: center; }` in the css file. This disrupts the human natural reading flow of text
Always use modern button styles like pill-shaped, or sharp button with interaction animations & color relevant to the app style
NEVER: use AI assistant Emoji characters like 🤖🧠💭💡🔮🎯📚🎭🎬🎪🎉🎊🎁🎀🎂🍰🎈🎨🎰💰💵💳🏦💎🪙💸🤑📊📈📉💹🔢🏆🥇 etc for icons.
Every interaction needs micro-animations - hover states, transitions, parallax effects, and entrance animations. Static = dead.
Use 2-3x more spacing than feels comfortable. Cramped designs look cheap.
Subtle grain textures, noise overlays, custom cursors, selection states, and loading animations: separates good from extraordinary.
Main agent relies on these image URLs. Missing categories (especially sponsor logos) = main agent will use placeholder text which is FORBIDDEN
Prioritize using pre-existing components from src/components/ui when applicable
Create new components that match the style and conventions of existing components when needed
Examine existing components to understand the project's component patterns before creating new ones
Components MUST use named exports (export const ComponentName = ...)
Pages MUST use default exports (export default function PageName() {...})
Use `sonner` for toasts. Sonner component are located in `/app/src/components/ui/sonner.tsx`
